assessments.zone: Kamina military base (BAKA) and its villages: Ntobo, Villa, Lumwe, Lumwe Villas (Baka health zone)
assessments.evidence: These localities form the Kamina base military complex (air base / training and brassage centre) operated by the FARDC and air force; the army is the main permanent force.

assessments.zone: Rural Kamina territory: secteurs Baka, Kinda and Songa (Kamina, Kinda, Songa health zones) incl. Kabondo-area villages, Muleba, Lusenja
assessments.evidence: No reports of armed-group control in Kamina territory's rural secteurs in 2025-2026; Mai-Mai/Bakata Katanga attacks in Haut-Lomami were in Bukama and other territories. State presence (police, local administration, customary chiefs) assumed.

Provincial capital with full state administration, provincial assembly and a large military garrison; the President visited in July 2026 and ACP reported the province calm in September 2026. No armed group activity reported in the town.

units.CD7302-kamina: Kamina territory (Haut-Lomami) is outside the active conflict areas of northern ex-Katanga; Mai-Mai/Bakata Katanga activity in 2026 was concentrated in neighbouring Bukama, Malemba-Nkulu and the Upemba area, not in Kamina. Kamina town is the provincial capital, with permanent PNC, FARDC and state administration, and hosted a presidential visit in July 2026. The Kamina military base (BAKA) south-east of town is an FARDC/FAC installation run by the army. Rural secteurs (Baka, Kinda, Songa) have no reported armed-group control and are assessed as default state presence (PNC).
